editorial:
Imagine two space cops who are great at solving crimes but even better at breaking things. That is exactly what you get with Kei and Yuri, the Lovely Angels. They are tasked with two huge jobs at once: figuring out why a space liner blew up and finding a scientist who vanished into thin air. The vibe is pure 90s sci-fi energy with bright colors and loud explosions. It feels like a wild ride where the main characters are barely keeping everything under control, which makes the whole experience feel exciting and unpredictable.

You will love the fast action and the funny bickering between the two leads. The plot has some surprising turns that keep you guessing, though some of the older animation might feel a bit dated to you. If you enjoy retro anime with high stakes, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: In the end, you find out the missing scientist was being used to build a deadly weapon. The conspiracy goes deeper than a simple accident, as the explosion was a cover-up. Kei and Yuri fight through a series of traps to stop the villains from launching the weapon. After a huge battle, they take down the bad guys and save the day, though they leave a trail of destruction behind them as usual.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves retro anime and space adventures.
